summary: A Power Macintosh 5500 all-in-one, working or repairable. The related 5400 and Performa 5xxx all-in-ones are of interest too; a bare logic board or a monitor on its own is not.
plausibilityNote: Sellers rarely give the model number: expect 'vintage apple computer', 'apple macintosh all in one', 'retro mac' with a photo and nothing else. Any 1990s beige all-in-one Macintosh is plausible and should reach the reviewer, which can read the model from the photographs. Japanese listings often say Performa rather than Power Macintosh.

criteria.text: An all-in-one Macintosh with the screen built into the case, not a separate tower and monitor
A Power Macintosh 5500, 5400, or a Performa 5xxx of the same all-in-one shape
A complete machine rather than a stripped case, bare logic board or loose parts
The CRT is not visibly burned in, cracked or badly discoloured
No signs of a leaked PRAM battery or corrosion on the visible boards
